name: SQL Server
about: No lab-tested knowledge yet: DBaba recognises SQL Server from its syntax or error format and answers with general SQL reasoning plus the notes below. These are notes from the official docs, not lab-proven rules.

notes.limit: SQL Server has no LIMIT: use SELECT TOP (n) ... ORDER BY ..., or ORDER BY ... OFFSET n ROWS FETCH NEXT m ROWS ONLY (2012+).
notes.concat: + joins text on SQL Server (NULL makes the whole result NULL); CONCAT() skips NULL parts.
notes.null_fn: ISNULL(x, 0) is SQL Server's two-argument null replacement (its result takes x's type); COALESCE works too and is portable.
notes.quotes: Names are quoted with [brackets] (or "double quotes" with QUOTED_IDENTIFIER on); text values use 'single quotes'.
notes.now: GETDATE() / SYSDATETIME() give the current date and time; CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) the date; CURRENT_TIMESTAMP works too.
notes.date_add: DATEADD(day, 7, d) adds to a date; there is no INTERVAL.
notes.date_diff: DATEDIFF(day, start, end) counts the day boundaries crossed (unit first, start before end, the opposite order to MySQL's DATEDIFF(end, start)).
notes.string_agg: STRING_AGG(col, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ...) (2017+) joins a group's text; there is no GROUP_CONCAT.
notes.identity: An auto-numbered key is INT IDENTITY(1,1); after an INSERT, SCOPE_IDENTITY() or OUTPUT inserted.id gives the new id.
notes.upsert: No ON DUPLICATE KEY / ON CONFLICT: use MERGE (carefully, with a unique key and HOLDLOCK) or UPDATE then INSERT WHERE NOT EXISTS in one transaction.
notes.case: Text comparison follows the column's collation; the usual default (..._CI_AS) ignores case.
notes.length: LEN(x) counts characters and ignores trailing spaces; DATALENGTH(x) counts bytes.
notes.position: CHARINDEX('x', text) finds where x starts (0 if missing).
notes.if: IIF(cond, a, b) (2012+) or CASE WHEN ... END.
notes.division: int / int drops the fraction (7 / 2 = 3); multiply by 1.0 first.
notes.boolean: There is no BOOLEAN type: BIT holds 0 / 1, and a condition can't be selected as a value (use CASE).
notes.dual: No DUAL: SELECT 1 needs no FROM.
